paper.title: GLUT: 3D Gaussian Lookup Table for Continuous Color Transformation
paper.usage: clean-room continuous explicit representation abstraction; no paper code, weights or data

execution_amendment.reason: the first implementation accidentally divided the intended monotone logistic projection twice, making the procedural oracle non-monotone
execution_amendment.action: replace it with endpoint-normalized monotone logistic projection and discard both pre-amendment reports

scientific_conclusion: At the frozen equal compact basis budget, the continuous Gaussian representation materially outperforms the regular lattice on all twelve procedural bounded operators while retaining positive sampled Jacobians and zero new cube-boundary pixels. This opens only a separately frozen photographic baseline against current explicit operators.
claim_ceiling: Procedural D0 representation evidence for a continuous explicit Gaussian colour basis; not photographic preference, film, stock, calibration, product integration or a reproduction of the paper model.
